ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOB$ and $\angle BOC$ are adjacent supplementary angles. $OD$ is the angle bisector of $\angle AOB$, and $OE$ is within $\angle BOC$ such that $\angle BOE=\frac{1}{2}\angle EOC$, and $\angle DOE={72}^\circ$. Find the degree measure of $\angle EOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle BOE = \frac{1}{2}\angle EOC$, \\
then $\angle BOC = \angle BOE + \angle EOC = 3\angle BOE$, \\
since $\angle DOE = 72^\circ$, \\
thus $\angle BOD = \angle DOE - \angle BOE = 72^\circ - \angle BOE$, \\
since $OD$ bisects $\angle AOB$, \\
thus $\angle AOB = 2\angle BOD = 144^\circ - 2\angle BOE$, \\
since $\angle AOB$ and $\angle BOC$ are supplementary, \\
thus $\angle AOB + \angle BOC = 180^\circ$, \\
therefore $144^\circ - 2\angle BOE + 3\angle BOE = 180^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle BOE = 36^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle EOC = 2\angle BOE = \boxed{72^\circ}$.
